item.title: Fly tipping of furniture and other items., 1st August
item.description:
As well as the items in the photos there is also a mattress stuffed behind the bins opposite. They were put there on Friday July 31st. The location is Brunel Rd where there is a small cul-de-sac and one set of blue bins for re-cycling and one set of green bins for other rubbish. These bins are meant to be for the use of the residents of the row of 6 houses behind but they are regularly being over-filled by fly-tippers and others who do not live in the houses. Would be grateful for your help and assistance in clearing these.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 25-31, Brunel Road, Rotherhithe, Greater London
